data.description:
Placeholder epic for Plan C from the UI/UX quality proposal (report: docs/proposals).

Problem: Reviewers grade visual_hierarchy and design_system_compliance by reading code/SVG with no quantitative signal. Provides deterministic numbers reviewers must incorporate.

Deliverables:
- plugins/dso/scripts/measure-spatial-metrics.sh: Playwright evaluate() against affected routes computing whitespace ratio, density score, alignment grid coverage against .claude/design.md spacing scale, tap-target compliance (>=44x44 per WCAG 2.5.5), bounding-box overlap incidents, edge-bleed incidents.
- JSON metrics file consumed by plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/design-systems-lead.md.
- Reviewer prompt update: require citing these numbers when scoring visual_hierarchy or design_system_compliance below 4.
- dso-config.conf thresholds (design.min_whitespace_ratio, design.max_density, etc.); threshold violations cap dimension score at 3.

Maps to: report's 'external mathematical linter' diagnosis. Cheap deterministic alternative to Plan B; standalone option if VLM cost is a non-starter.

Relationship: largely subsumed by Plan B if both ship. Standalone fallback.

Measurable outcome: Per-route metrics trended over time. Reviewer findings cite concrete numbers replacing 'feels crowded'.

Status: placeholder — requires /dso:brainstorm to expand into a full epic spec.
data.title: Plan C: Spatial metrics co-processor for design-systems-lead reviewer
